newsitem.title: USA: NUI names Mark Abramovic CFO.
newsitem.headline: NUI names Mark Abramovic CFO.

text.p: NUI Corp said Thursday it had appointed Mark Abramovic as chief financial officer and senior vice president of the company.
Abramovic, who will assume the post on September 2, held the same titles at Equitable Resources Inc, it said.
NUI said in a statement he will fill a position that has been vacant for several months.
Equitable said in a separate statement that a search committee was looking for someone to replace Abramovic, who will leave the company on August 29.
Based in Bedminster, NUI is a multi-state gas distribution, energy sales and services company, while Equitable is an energy exploration, distribution and marketing company.
